faq.question: What is the minimum order quantity?
faq.answer: Minimum quantities vary by product and customisation method. The quotation engine shows accurate options for the selected product.

faq.question: How long is the production lead time?
faq.answer: Most projects take two to four weeks after artwork and sample approval. Complex custom products may take longer.

faq.question: Can you help with design?
faq.answer: Yes. We can advise on product selection, print placement and artwork preparation.

faq.question: Do you ship internationally?
faq.answer: International delivery can be arranged. Shipping is quoted separately based on destination and order size.

faq.question: What file formats do you accept?
faq.answer: Vector artwork is preferred. High-resolution PNG and PDF files may also be suitable depending on the print method.
